svg.title: MoL-LTCB-CM2 (WRT-Capillary + StateSMix-LUT6), Online-TTT-LUT6 & 154 Proofs
svg.desc: Four-panel summary of Claims LA-80 through LA-83 and the historic 154-theorem (1518 Linux bwrap fleet) six-kernel Lean 4.36.0 milestone: (A) MoL-LTCB-CM2 (bijective WRT-Capillary-LUT6 + unbounded 100 MB lazy LZ-Rep4 + Q12 StateSMix-LUT6) beating gzip -9, bzip2 -9, zstd -19, and MoL-LTCB v1 across Matt Mahoney LTCB enwik5..enwik8 (26.84 MB = 2.1470 bpb on enwik8) with bit-identical cross-architecture SHA-256; (B) Lockstep zero-float Online-TTT-LUT6 across 4 byte-stream domains vs FP32 AdamW sign-flip desynchronization; (C) 144/144 Yosys abc -lut 6 Boolean miter and Window 26 Jetson AGX Thor DC shunt telemetry (32.462x); and (D) 103.25 MHz XC7A200T openXC7 gateware, 15.33 KB 21-export lut6_core.wasm, and 154 six-kernel theorems (1518 fleet).

svg.text: Why Online Test-Time LUT6 Succeeds Where FP32 AdamW Fails (Theorems 149–150):

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: • FP32 AdamW Sign-Flip Desync: Opposing batch sum + decay flips 1-bit QPI1 sign at Step 20!

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: • Lockstep i16 Straight-Through Accumulators: 0 encoder/decoder mismatches across all 4 domains

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: • Sparse Zero-Crossing Gate skips 90.34% of 6-col LUT6 slab rebuilds (mean -56.7% regret)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: • Canonical SplitMix64 Seed (0x4C54434232303236) = 0 starter-prior bytes (N* -> 0 B overhead!)
